title: Genesis #1 (1997) DC Comics The Source Material Of All Power - Doomed!
descriptionText: The product is a comic book titled "Genesis #1" published by DC Comics in 1997. This comic book is the first issue of the series "Genesis" and falls under the genre of comics. The story revolves around the character Genesis, taking readers on an action-packed and thrilling journey. Set in the Modern Age era of US Comics, this comic book is a valuable collectible for fans and collectors alike.
